/* NUM_PHASES must be set to 4 in the driver's CONFIG section. */

volatile unsigned char image_red[8]
= { 0b11111000, 0b11111100, 0b00110110, 0b00110011, 0b00110011, 0b00110110, 0b00111100, 0b11111000 };

volatile unsigned char image_green[8]
= { 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111 };

volatile unsigned char image_rotate_red[NUM_PHASES][8]
= {
    { 0b11111000, 0b11111100, 0b00110110, 0b00110011, 0b00110011, 0b00110110, 0b00111100, 0b11111000 },
    { 0b10000011, 0b10000011, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11000011, 0b01100110, 0b00111100, 0b00011000 },
    { 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111 },
    { 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111 }
};

volatile unsigned char image_rotate_green[NUM_PHASES][8]
= {
    { 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111 },
    { 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111 },
    { 0b00111100, 0b01111110, 0b01100110, 0b01100110, 0b01100110, 0b01100110, 0b01111110, 0b00111100 },
    { 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111, 0b11111111 }
